text: The doctor was nice. But my appointment was at 4:30pm and I waited til 5:30pm. I asked for a female doctor 3 times and they still had the male doctor meet me. restaurant_name: Kullapat Polyclinic & IVF Center (กุลพัฒน์การแพทย์ สหคลินิค)
text:
First off, I'd like to apologize to the facility for making the mistake of missing appointment. I got my days mixed up and confused and that was entirely my fault. However, when I came in for my next day appointment not one receptionist greeted  me when I walked through the door and completely ignored me when I walked up to the front counter and I stood there for minutes. There were 5 lady receptionists there and no one looked or spoke to me. This greatly crushed my spirit. I just hope that my experience with the doctor will be much more nurturing and kinder that the cold welcome I got from the workers. I'm disappointed and sad

Update: first, it has been much time since this original post and I wanted to say that once I was brought in to see the doctor it was a much better experience. The doctor was knowledgeable and even mannered and clearly went through all options and processes of each. The female staff was very kind and respectful. So in the end it was a positive experience. I just feel that as an Asian and American born, the initial greeting and communication upon visiting the clinic was a bit indifferent. But don’t let that bother you too much as the goal is far too important.

text: This is a great place, they see foreigners for appointments on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, but the wait is very long. Dr Supreeya was the doctor I saw who delivered my son and she's amazing. Speaks perfect English and is very kind and gentle. Had a natural birth with her!

text:
The management was terrible, to the point of being the worst. The wait was incredibly long.
1. The first time I went for a checkup... they told me to come at 5:00 PM. I arrived at 4:45 PM... but I actually got checked at almost 8:00 PM. They didn't give me any advance notice about the procedures and how long it would take.
2. The second time I arrived at 3:30 PM to buy medicine (I called beforehand to say I'd come in, but the staff didn't say anything). I didn't get my medicine until 5:00 PM. I'm confused because this is a public hospital with a lot of customers. The doctors are excellent.
But the management system is even worse than some government hospitals.
I really need to improve. There are many methods. Try searching the internet for how to do it. I can even use IoT. I'm very disappointed with the management.
